items.html: Therefore know also that these three Hassadim less a third, which are revealed, always remain in the Yesod of ZA, and their returning light ascends from below upward to illuminate and grow it. Also know that all this is now, at the time of the Gadlut of ZA; however, at the time of coupling, then all five Hassadim descend into the Yesod of ZA for the sake of the coupling. And understand this.
